entities.summary: Marek Jurek is a right-wing politician who was Marshal of the Sejm and Member of the European Parliament. Since 20 April 2007 he has been the leader of the aspirant party Right of the Republic. Politically, he is most known for being a Marshal of the Sejm in the years 2005–2007.
